biggest_catch: The flyer is marked a limited-time offer that can change or be discontinued at any time, so the $50-per-referral amount is current as observed on 2026-09-23 but not guaranteed.
catches: Limited-time offer: subject to change or discontinuation at any time without notice.
Referrer payout is credited only after the friend's 90-day qualification window, by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day after the friend's account opening.
Both referrer and friend accounts must be open and in good standing at payout time.
Friend must be a new TruNorth checking customer (no existing TruNorth checking); referrer must be tax owner on an active checking account in good standing and at least 16.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: TruNorth Bank's official Refer-A-Friend flyer (trunorthbank.com, flyer TNB-1186 rev 02/09/2026) offers a $50 bonus to the referring customer.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring Customer receives $50 credited to their account for each qualifying referral; cap is up to 5 referral bonus deposits ($250 total) per calendar year.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: referrer writes their name on the official referral slip and gives it to the friend; friend brings the slip to any TruNorth Bank office, opens a new personal checking account, provides the referrer's name at account opening, and within 90 days enrolls in eStatements plus either $1,000 in aggregate direct deposits or 25 point-of-sale debit transactions of $10 or more.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $50 bonus is credited to the referrer's account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day after the friend's account opening.

eligibility: Referrer: tax owner on an active TruNorth Bank checking account in good standing, at least 16 years old. Referred friend: a new TruNorth Bank checking customer only.
notes: The friend receives no stated bonus; only the referrer is paid. This program supersedes the stale Abington-era flyer rejected under R0588; the flyer here is the current TruNorth Bank version.
payout_quote: Receive $50 when your friends and family bring this referral slip to any TruNorth Bank office, open a new checking account, and take the steps below within 90 days of account opening
payout_value_note: Cash credited to the referrer's TruNorth Bank account, not a gift card.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: No cost to refer; a paper referral slip is used at a branch.

s4.note: Cap: up to 5 referral bonus deposits ($250) per calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official flyer (rev 02/09/2026, observed 2026-09-23) but marked limited-time and subject to change without notice.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official flyer: referrer writes their name on the referral slip; friend presents the slip at any TruNorth Bank office when opening the new checking account and names the referrer.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions within 90 days of account opening: enroll in eStatements AND complete $1,000 in aggregate direct deposits OR 25 point-of-sale debit transactions of $10 or more.

steps: Write your name on the official TruNorth Bank referral slip and give it to friends and family.
Friend brings the slip to any TruNorth Bank office, opens a new personal checking account, and names you as referrer.
Friend enrolls in eStatements and within 90 days completes $1,000 in aggregate direct deposits or 25 point-of-sale debit transactions of $10 or more.
The $50 bonus is credited to your account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day the friend's account was opened.
timing: Payout by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day after the friend's account opening.
